title: asset.create_gap_report input
description: Records one analysis of what an episode's script needs and the asset library does not have, as a new DRAFT report. It cannot approve: section 10.1 gives asset_analysis a required user gate, so the report a user approves is the one the gate acts on. Every line is either a story fact an existing asset satisfies or a story fact with no asset yet.

episodeId.description: The episode this analysis is about.

scriptVersionId.description: The script version that was analysed.

summary.description: What the analysis found, in a sentence or two.

basedOnVersionId.description: The report this analysis replaces, or empty for the first.

items.description: One line per story fact the script needs. The order is the report's order and the ordinals are assigned from it.

assetType.description: One of the asset types, such as character, location, prop or costume.

storyEntityId.description: The story entity the asset is needed for, when the analysis can name one.

storyEntityName.description: The story fact's name, which is what a MISSING line has instead of an identifier.

assetId.description: The asset that satisfies this line. Required when status is satisfied.

usageRole.description: What the asset is used as, such as reference or subject. Empty means reference.

required.description: Whether the production cannot proceed without it. A missing REQUIRED asset blocks a batch.

notes.description: Anything a reviewer should know, such as why it is optional.
